blocked.clinical_command_receipts_lineage: BLOCKED: clinical_command_receipts, the durable idempotency claim table, is created only by migration 20260819_0003_clinical_command_receipts, which sits on a different Alembic head from the Blood Bank lineage. Upgrading to 20260901_0004 alone leaves the table absent and every guarded Blood Bank write fails with UndefinedTable. The verification database required that migration's own DDL to be applied separately. Root cause is the pre-existing duplicate revision id 20260819_0003 and the unrelated multiple-head state, which are out of scope for this phase and were not modified.
blocked.requirements_lock_missing_signxml: BLOCKED for lock-only installs: signxml>=4.2.0 is declared in backend/requirements.txt but absent from backend/requirements-lock.txt, so an environment built from the lock file alone cannot import app.security.saml_service and therefore cannot start the application. Documented only; the dependency manifests were not modified in this phase.
